text: Window Placement: user permission responses for Window.getScreens() aren't being logged
For the new Multi-Screen Window Placement API, we'd like to log user permission responses. But although we're logging Permissions.Action.WindowPlacement, the data can't be accessed.

I can't get our UMA dashboard to actually show the name or data for *WindowPlacement, as I can for *Geolocation.

We log Permissions.Action.WindowPlacement (just like other permissions actions) here:
https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:components/permissions/permission_uma_util.cc;drc=1156b5f891de178171e71b9221a96bef1ced3d3b;l=749
The histograms.xml entry is here:
https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:tools/metrics/histograms/histograms_xml/permissions/histograms.xml;drc=a7ae2e73f857edba50afa585ff8bfdc85c706be3;l=24

Testing on canary, chrome://histograms/ Monitoring Mode emits the expected value when I accept the prompt from the "Update screens" button on https://michaelwasserman.github.io/window-placement-demo/

- Histogram: Permissions.Action.WindowPlacement recorded 2 samples, mean = 2.0 (flags = 0x41)
0  -O                                                                        (1 = 50.0%)
1  ...
4  -O                                                                        (1 = 50.0%) {50.0%}
5  ...

I didn't see any glaring mistakes per https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src.git/+/HEAD/tools/metrics/histograms/README.md
Perhaps our usage is too low for the dashboard to surface data, or we missed a step somewhere?
phillis@ or dmurph@, do you know what we are missing? Should we ping the metrics team or schedule office hours?
